'''2011 Luxembourg Regionals Carlos Navarro DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Carlos Navarro]] at [[2011 Luxembourg Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V) / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)|VB4-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi-pre.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Carlos
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]

== Decklist ==

The sheet says the deck is the same as the player's [[2011 Belgium Regionals Carlos Navarro DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)|list from the day before]]. The list below is that list.
